title: rec-c1-6-lifecycle-retention-wire
summary: REC-C1.6 closes two gaps left at REC-C1.5 closure: (1) lifecycle-safe delete_session — typed ServiceError::SessionStillActive refuses destructive windows on a still-live probe WITHOUT auto-stopping it; (2) retention/tail facts on the events_read wire — RetentionFacts {retained_from_seq, history_truncated} and TailFacts {state, tail_seq} now appear on every page, and the CursorStale envelope carries a structured json content item alongside the existing text.

applied.title: SessionsContext::connected_sessions was never populated
applied.resolution: Fixed in cycle (commit 7afb47ad): wired live marker at session_start{action=spawn|attach} Ok arm and cleared at session_stop (both Stopped and AlreadyStopped arms). Load action is defensive-removed. Precondition in SessionsService::delete_session now reads a populated set.
